sources.governing_condition_default_exception: autoOrient reads EXIF Orientation and removes the tag; orientation carried elsewhere such as XMP is not handled. Order matters for rotate/resize/extract; multipage limitations apply.
sources.applicability: Supports explicit single orientation stage and fixture needs; not a guarantee for every decoder/format.

sources.title: Sharp output, profiles and metadata
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current Sharp documentation consulted with v0.35.5 release identified separately.
sources.locator: keepIccProfile(), withIccProfile(), keepMetadata(), withMetadata(); JPEG defaults.
sources.observed_operation: Opened official API page and read output profile/metadata policy descriptions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Without keepMetadata, output converts to sRGB and strips metadata including ICC; keepMetadata retains EXIF, ICC, XMP and IPTC; withMetadata keeps most descriptive metadata and adds sRGB ICC if appropriate. JPEG defaults include quality 80 and 4:2:0 chroma subsampling.
sources.applicability: Concrete default/privacy/color behavior to override explicitly per output role.

sources.title: Portable Network Graphics (PNG) Specification, Third Edition
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation, Third Edition, 2025-06-24
sources.locator: §6.2 unassociated alpha; §11.3.2 color chunks; §11.3.3 text; §11.3.4.5 eXIf, historical metadata and conflicts; §13.4 privacy; edition heading.
sources.observed_operation: Opened current W3C Recommendation; checked edition, alpha representation, eXIf semantics/conflicts, color/text chunk families, privacy language and decoder notes.

sources.applicability: Current primary basis for PNG alpha and metadata/privacy planning; not proof that a candidate library strips or preserves every chunk.

sources.title: CSS Color Module Level 5
sources.released_version_or_commit: W3C Working Draft, 2026-09-13
sources.locator: §3.5 Effect of Non-Unity Alpha on color-mix; document status at §§0–1.
sources.observed_operation: Opened dated W3C Working Draft and read its premultiply/interpolate/unpremultiply example and status notice.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The draft says premultiplication and unpremultiplication must not be omitted for color interpolation with non-unity alpha. It concerns CSS color mixing, not a normative image-resizing algorithm, and remains work in progress.
sources.applicability: Supports the alpha-aware filtering recommendation by analogy to interpolation math; not evidence that a specific image library implements it.

sources.title: Recommendation ITU-T T.86 (V2): APPn Markers
sources.released_version_or_commit: ITU-T T.86 (V2), approved 2024-02-13; common text with ISO/IEC 10918-4
sources.locator: §§1, 6 and Annex A/Table A.1; APPn reserved marker and identifier list.
sources.observed_operation: Read official ITU e-publication and official PDF text; checked version, scope, APPn policy and Annex A.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: APPn includes EXIF, XMP, ICC_PROFILE, thumbnails/previews, MPF, Photoshop IRB/IPTC, comments and application-specific records. The standard says T.81 recommends but does not require removal across application domains, discourages removal within its domain, and says unknown markers should be skipped/preserved when updating.
sources.applicability: Primary JPEG APPn inventory. A privacy policy must classify segments and preserve approved output ICC rather than blindly dropping all APPn; the registry is not exhaustive for private/nonstandard content.

critic_scope_note: SRC-PNG-02 remains bound to the 2003 Second Edition and is not rebound. CRITIC-PNG-01 records the current Third Edition.
source_id_policy: Investigator and critic source records are carried without rebinding or alteration. Reviser checks use distinct REV-* IDs. SRC-PNG-02 remains the 2003 Second Edition; CRITIC-PNG-01 and REV-W3C-PNG-01 identify the 2025 Third Edition.

F-01.detail: Specify premultiplied-alpha filtering and unpremultiplication when alpha is nonzero as component policy; candidate behavior remains unverified. CSS Color Level 5 is a Working Draft about color interpolation, not a normative resize rule.

F-02.detail: Keep SRC-PNG-02 bound to the Second Edition; preserve CRITIC-PNG-01 and add separate REV-W3C-PNG-01 for Third Edition context.

F-03.detail: Add ITU-T T.86 V2 APPn inventory; require owner-selected formats and per-format encoded-output allowlist checks. Not exhaustive, and blanket APPn removal can discard ICC/color data.

F-04.detail: Atomic publication depends on actual destination/staging semantics; use confirmed same-filesystem rename, otherwise a commit-marker/state protocol. No behavior tested.

F-05.detail: Issue and linked patch commit corroborate chronology. Reporter describes regressions; maintainer says patch reverted as incorrect. No independent root cause or current-release behavior established.

checks_executed: Desk research and primary-source review only. No product image, filesystem publication, fixture, code, build, perceptual, malicious-input, benchmark or integration check was executed.
